evidence: CCTBA is very reactive with H, and H terminated on the substrate surface functions as a nucleation site. We therefore pre-treated the TaNx substrate with hydrogen plasma at a plasma power of 100 W for 1 min to hydrogenate the TaNx surface. These authors reported that carbonyl groups are quite stable on H/Si in the form of Co2(CO)6 and semi-bridging CO groups during the initial reaction, and that the presence of surface-bound CO is negligible on SiO2 because of weakening of the bond strength of CO with the Co center. However, without annealing at 300°C, organic ligands such as t-butyl, carbonyl, methyl, and their products remain in the Co films.
